creditTopUpBlock.title: Credit top-up
creditTopUpBlock.description: Choose credit packages with recent activity, monthly usage and a depletion forecast in context.
creditTopUpBlock.compositionBody: Preserves the video's activity cards and two-column purchase layout. Reuses Container, Card, ChartContainer, ChartTooltipContent, SegmentedBar, ChartLegend, RadioGroup, Button and InlineNotice. Recharts compositions retain the stem, area and bar forms. Colors follow the original allocation segments: chart-5 purple for support, chart-1 blue for code review and chart-3 orange for research. Each title, icon and chart shares its category color with the matching allocation segment and legend dot; stems and area fills retain translucency. Surfaces, typography, radii and states follow the library. Container queries switch to one column without adding an application shell.
creditTopUpBlock.dataContractBody: data supplies total monthly credits, daily usage, snapshot and reset timestamps, usage categories and packages. periodCredits drives monthly totals; recentCredits and history remain independent activity metrics. Depletion uses remaining credits divided by daily usage. Sub-day packages say less than a day; non-finite coverage estimates are omitted. Invalid locales fall back to en-US; invalid time zones fall back to UTC while preserving a valid locale. Quotes retain host-provided currencies and up to 20 decimal places. Supports packageId / defaultPackageId / onPackageChange and English/Chinese labels. Replace data and label objects when updating them. The demo uses an October 22, 2026 snapshot.
creditTopUpBlock.behaviorBody: Selecting a package updates the primary theme-colored action's credits and price. The radio group supports keyboard input. Uncontrolled selection initializes when the first available package arrives and survives reordering; stale IDs prevent confirmation. onConfirm receives the complete package; pending requests lock selection and actions, while rejected requests show an error and allow retry. Changing the selection or quote clears old errors and ignores failures from the previous selection. onCancel delegates dismissal to the host. Missing handlers, unavailable packages and disabled states prevent submission. Includes loading, error, empty and checkout-error demos, chart tooltips, keyboard inspection and screen reader tables without a visible data expander. Demo cancellation and state changes clear previous errors. Payment, authorization, final quote validation and balance refresh belong to the host.
